data.one_liner: Flutter widget for selecting a time range with custom steps and time blocks.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to select a start and end time range within defined boundaries. Allows you to specify time steps, time blocks, and customized styles for buttons, text, and borders.
use_when: You need to build a form that requires users to select a time range.
You need to enforce specific time blocks or step intervals for scheduling.
avoid_when: You need a standard native date and time picker dialog rather than an inline widget.
You require complex event-based calendar scheduling.
strengths: Allows configuration of time steps and time blocks.
Fully customizable appearance including colors and text styles.
weaknesses: Limited to selecting time ranges within a single day/time configuration as provided by the widget.
No documentation regarding advanced localization beyond device formats.
data.minimal_example:
TimeRange(
    fromTitle: Text('From', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
    toTitle: Text('To', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
    firstTime: TimeOfDay(hour: 14, minute: 30),
    lastTime: TimeOfDay(hour: 20, minute: 00),
    timeStep: 10,
    timeBlock: 30,
    onRangeCompleted: (range) => print(range),
  )
